issues.detail: Hebrew 'וְאֵת יֶתֶר הָאָמוֹן' means 'and the rest of the multitude/people' (הָאָמוֹן = the multitude/rabble), but Chinese renders it as '剩下的工匠' (the remaining craftsmen/artisans). 'אָמוֹן' does not mean 'craftsman' (that would be 'חָרָשׁ' or similar); it means a crowd/multitude. This changes the meaning of the verse.
